'''Sebolto's drug cartel''' was the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Sebolto]]'s illegal [[Death stick/Legends|death stick]] smuggling enterprise operating in various star systems. The cartel saw an increase in sales when his majesty made a deal with [[High Priestess/Legends|High Priestess]] [[Komari Vosa]] of the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]], adding the cult's neurotoxins to the death sticks to make them more potent and, as such, more addictive. Cartel operations in the [[Gazzari Minor system/Legends|Gazzari Minor system]] ended after smuggler [[Bendix Fust]] was arrested and ratted out the whole operation after being caught by the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] at a transfer station there. Operations in the [[Coruscant system/Legends|Coruscant system]] were shut down by ex-[[True Mandalorians|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Montross (bounty hunter)|Montross]]. The cartel came to an end when Sebolto died trying to escape Jango Fett, falling into a vat of his own death sticks.
